kill_calibration: 99.0th percentile of benign val sustained peak confidence
alert_calibration: max Youden's J on TUNE (peak confidence)
escalation_calibration: off percentile of the longest continuous alert over benign val processes (min = sustain); percentile chosen on TUNE
escalation_selection_rule: most TUNE attacks killed with TUNE benign kill rate <= 0.02
selection_rule: most TUNE attacks killed with TUNE benign false-kill rate <= 0.02; ties -> fewer syscalls before kill
